prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style from the reference: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or extra paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with small label "Memory trick".
Heading verbatim: "återkoppling". English meaning verbatim: "feedback".
Scene: A teacher returning a learner's illustrated project with helpful comments and encouraging check marks.
Memory caption verbatim: "återkoppling = feedback.".
Bottom Swedish example verbatim: "Jag fick bra återkoppling på mitt arbete.". Teach only this sense.
